groups.name: hephaestus.sync
groups.description: Provider-agnostic sync scheduler settings (run-on-startup, cron, cooldown, backfill, filters)

groups.name: hephaestus.integration.github.sync
groups.description: GitHub-specific sync tuning (GraphQL timeouts, incremental buffer, backfill page size)

groups.name: hephaestus.sync.nats
groups.description: NATS JetStream integration for real-time event processing

groups.name: hephaestus.integration.github
groups.description: GitHub API authentication and App configuration

groups.name: hephaestus.integration.slack
groups.description: Slack integration toggle and OAuth client credentials

groups.name: hephaestus.agent.image
groups.description: Shared image reference for the Pi practice and Hephaestus agent runtime

properties.name: hephaestus.agent.max-active-compositions
properties.description: Most compositions whose inputs one worker loads at once. Additional attempts wait without loading composition inputs. This does not reduce review sandbox capacity.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.github.sync.graphql-timeout
properties.description: Timeout for standard GraphQL operations. Accepts duration format: 30s, 1m, PT30S.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.github.sync.extended-graphql-timeout
properties.description: Extended timeout for complex GraphQL operations, such as review comments. Accepts duration format: 60s, 1m, PT60S.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.github.sync.pagination-throttle
properties.description: Delay between pagination requests that keeps the load on the GitHub API low. Accepts duration format: 200ms, PT0.2S.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.github.sync.incremental-sync-enabled
properties.description: Whether to use incremental sync based on last sync timestamp

properties.name: hephaestus.sync.cooldown-minutes
properties.description: Minimum minutes between consecutive sync operations

properties.name: hephaestus.sync.nats.enabled
properties.description: Whether NATS JetStream integration is enabled

properties.name: hephaestus.sync.nats.server
properties.description: NATS server URL (e.g., nats://localhost:4222)

properties.name: hephaestus.sync.nats.durable-consumer-name
properties.description: Durable consumer name for JetStream subscriptions (empty for ephemeral)

properties.name: hephaestus.webapp.url
properties.description: Set the webapp's base URL for generated links.

properties.name: hephaestus.workspace.init-default
properties.description: Whether to bootstrap a PAT-based workspace on startup (for local development)

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.enabled
properties.description: Master toggle for the Slack integration (OAuth install, lifecycle listeners, outbound messaging)

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.client-id
properties.description: Use the Slack app's client ID to connect workspaces to Slack.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.client-secret
properties.description: Use the Slack app's client secret to connect workspaces to Slack.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.redirect-uri
properties.description: Redirect URI registered on the Slack app. It must match the authorization URL that Hephaestus builds for the Slack connection.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.api-base
properties.description: Base URL of the Slack API. Override it only to point at a mock server in tests.

properties.name: hephaestus.agent.image.reference
properties.description: Image reference used by Pi practice sandboxes and the Hephaestus container. Production must be digest-pinned (registry/path@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>).

properties.name: hephaestus.agent.image.pull-policy
properties.description: Startup pull behaviour.

properties.name: hephaestus.agent.image.require-digest
properties.description: Refuses startup unless the agent image reference is pinned by digest.

properties.name: hephaestus.runtime.server.enabled
properties.description: Runs the server role, which serves the API, syncs provider work and delivers feedback. Turn it off in a worker-only or webhook-only container.

properties.name: hephaestus.runtime.worker.enabled
properties.description: Runs the worker role, which runs sandboxed practice reviews and conversation turns. Only a container with this role may mount the Docker socket.

properties.name: hephaestus.runtime.webhook.enabled
properties.description: Runs the webhook role, which receives provider webhooks and publishes them to NATS JetStream. Under the prod profile, this role needs NATS.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.gitlab.enabled
properties.description: Turns on the GitLab integration, which syncs GitLab groups and projects and delivers feedback on merge requests.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.outline.enabled
properties.description: Turns on the Outline integration, which lets workspaces connect Outline and syncs its documents. Each workspace admin still connects their workspace separately.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.outline.allowed-origins
properties.description: Outline origins that workspace connections and Outline sign-in may use, as a comma-separated list such as https://wiki.example.com. Each must be an HTTPS origin without a path. Hephaestus refuses every Outline address that is not listed.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.outline.sync.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the full reconcile of each workspace's Outline document mirror. Uses six fields: second, minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.outline.sync.catch-up-delay
properties.description: Pause between the catch-up passes that resume Outline collections still awaiting a complete sync. A pass without pending collections makes no API calls. Accepts an ISO-8601 duration such as PT5M.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.signing-secret
properties.description: Signing secret of the Slack app, which verifies inbound Events API and interactivity requests. Required when the Slack integration is on, or the server and webhook roles do not start.

properties.name: hephaestus.integration.slack.conversation-ingest.enabled
properties.description: Lets workspaces ingest Slack channel messages for conversation reviews. Nothing is read until a workspace admin activates a channel. Set it to false to turn off channel ingestion for the whole instance.

properties.name: hephaestus.workspace.default.login
properties.description: GitHub organization or user login that the startup PAT workspace syncs. Required when hephaestus.workspace.init-default turns on the startup workspace.

properties.name: hephaestus.workspace.default.token
properties.description: GitHub personal access token for the startup PAT workspace. Required when hephaestus.workspace.init-default turns on the startup workspace.

properties.name: hephaestus.database.allow-insecure-remote
properties.description: Lets the prod profile connect to a remote PostgreSQL host without TLS. Without it, startup fails unless the JDBC URL sets sslmode to require, verify-ca or verify-full. Hosts other than localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 and postgres count as remote.

properties.name: hephaestus.database.migration-wait
properties.description: How long a role waits at start for the database migration of its release, and how long a migration waits while another migration runs. After it, the process stops and names the reason.

properties.name: hephaestus.dev.seed-enabled
properties.description: Exposes the development endpoint that local seed scripts use to read the practice versions that a review would pin. Use it only in local development, never in production.

properties.name: hephaestus.dev.trigger-enabled
properties.description: Lets requests to paths under /api/dev/ pass the security filter without sign-in. Use it only in local development, never in production.

properties.name: hephaestus.fabric.root
properties.description: Local directory for the bare Git mirrors and the evidence folders of running reviews. The process must be able to write to it. Its contents are not durable application state.

properties.name: hephaestus.public-activity.enabled
properties.description: Allows public activity pages on this instance until an instance admin changes the switch in the admin console. Each workspace must also opt in.

properties.name: hephaestus.public-activity.repository-visibility-max-age
properties.description: How recently a sync must have confirmed that a repository is public for its work to appear on public activity pages. Must be positive. Accepts 48h, 2d, PT48H.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: Most PostgreSQL connections that one process holds in its pool. A worker can hold two connections per running review. Keep the sum over all processes below the PostgreSQL connection limit.

properties.name: spring.datasource.hikari.minimum-idle
properties.description: The minimum number of idle database connections that this process tries to keep in its pool.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.github.client-id
properties.description: Client ID of the GitHub OAuth App for sign-in. Set it with its client secret: a provider with only one of the two is not seeded. It seeds the github login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.github.client-secret
properties.description: Client secret of the GitHub OAuth App for sign-in. Set it with its client ID. It seeds the github login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.github.display-name
properties.description: Label of the GitHub button on the sign-in or account-linking page. It seeds the github login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.gitlab.client-id
properties.description: Client ID of the GitLab OAuth application for sign-in. Set it with its client secret: a provider with only one of the two is not seeded. It seeds the gitlab login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.gitlab.client-secret
properties.description: Client secret of the GitLab OAuth application for sign-in. Set it with its client ID. It seeds the gitlab login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.gitlab.display-name
properties.description: Label of the GitLab button on the sign-in or account-linking page. It seeds the gitlab login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.gitlab.base-url
properties.description: Origin of the GitLab instance for sign-in, such as https://gitlab.example.com. It seeds the gitlab login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.slack.client-id
properties.description: Use the Slack app's client ID to link a Slack account. It falls back to the Slack workspace-install credentials. Set it with its client secret: a provider with only one of the two is not seeded. It seeds the slack login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.slack.client-secret
properties.description: Use the Slack app's client secret to link a Slack account. It falls back to the Slack workspace-install credentials. Set it with its client ID. It seeds the slack login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.slack.display-name
properties.description: Label of the Slack button on the sign-in or account-linking page. It seeds the slack login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.outline.client-id
properties.description: Client ID of the Outline OAuth application for linking an Outline account. Set it with its client secret: a provider with only one of the two is not seeded. It seeds the outline login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.outline.client-secret
properties.description: Client secret of the Outline OAuth application for linking an Outline account. Set it with its client ID. It seeds the outline login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.outline.display-name
properties.description: Label of the Outline button on the sign-in or account-linking page. It seeds the outline login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.auth.login-providers.outline.base-url
properties.description: Origin of the Outline instance for account linking, such as https://wiki.example.com. Required when the client ID is set. It seeds the outline login provider at startup only when that provider does not exist yet. Later changes go through Instance administration, Login providers.

properties.name: hephaestus.features.flags.gitlab-workspace-creation
properties.description: Lets admins create GitLab workspaces in the UI and the API.

properties.name: hephaestus.features.flags.page-experience-metrics
properties.description: Lets the browser of a signed-in reader measure how fast each visit loads and responds and report it to the page experience metrics. In the EU, turning it on can require consent or a documented legal basis.

properties.name: spring.application.version
properties.description: Version that the application reports in its logs, traces and release card. The deployment sets it from the release.

properties.name: logging.structured.ecs.service.version
properties.description: Each log record names this version as its service version.

properties.name: hephaestus.mentor.turn.capacity
properties.description: The conversation turns that all workers together run at once: the number of workers times the conversation turns of each. While every one of them runs a turn, a question that could start next says that Hephaestus is answering other questions. Unset, no question says why it waits. The Helm chart sets it. Must be at least 1 when set.

values.description: Follows this deployment's own image tag, so the pair always matches.
Production — digest-pinned. Imported by spring.config.import from the signed release asset.
